title: Add a source link and retrieval date to every table row
decision_impact: Makes any decision auditable line by line
evidence: No guessing about where a value came from

title: Keep blank cells blank and flag them instead of substituting estimates
decision_impact: Prevents fabricated values entering a decision

title: Add a decision-readiness panel that counts open questions and flagged values
decision_impact: Shows at a glance whether a decision is defensible

title: Show an as-of timestamp and the next official filing deadline on every data page
decision_impact: Prevents stale injury data being used in a decision

title: Run the row-source validator and internal link checker on every push
decision_impact: A broken link or unsourced row is caught before publishing
evidence: GitHub Docs describes publishing from a branch

title: Add an injury x depth-chart join that shows which string would take the snaps
decision_impact: Directly addresses the 2nd/3rd/4th-string deficiency requirement

title: Add a conflict detector for 'No Injuries Reported' vs official news headlines
decision_impact: Removes contradictory inputs before they reach a model
evidence: An actual conflict is already visible

title: Add the official weekly inactives list as the availability authority
decision_impact: Inactives are closer to game time than practice reports

title: Add a correlation matrix view with method, n and confidence information
decision_impact: Makes 'determine correlation values' reviewable

title: Add a validation-gate pass/fail badge to every strategy
decision_impact: Prevents unvalidated strategies from being used

title: Add a pre-registration hash field for each strategy
decision_impact: Frees the evaluation from post-hoc tuning

title: Add a frozen out-of-sample evaluation window on the leaderboard
decision_impact: Separates in-sample fit from genuine predictive skill

title: Add a leg-correlation guard before any parlay or prop combo is eligible
decision_impact: Correlated legs change parlay risk materially

title: Add a bet-type risk panel using official loss percentages
decision_impact: Gives reviewers a common risk baseline
evidence: Official state report publishes loss rates

title: Add JSON/CSV downloads for every table
decision_impact: Allows independent line-by-line review outside the browser

title: Group pages by category with a persistent dashboard sidebar
decision_impact: Reduces time to find the evidence behind a decision
evidence: GitHub Docs describes the site structure

title: Add an explicit decision log recording the chosen path and reviewer
decision_impact: Makes the 'choose before implementing' gate enforceable

title: Add triage fields (owner, due date, disposition) to Flagged for Review
decision_impact: Turns flags into resolvable work items

title: Add a verbatim glossary of official designations and bet types
decision_impact: Prevents inconsistent interpretation of official labels

title: Add table sorting/filtering and responsive table wrappers
decision_impact: Makes large verified tables readable on any screen

title: Guard shared output paths across the four site generators
decision_impact: Prevents a routine rebuild from silently replacing the canonical landing page (this audit had to restore index.html and README.md after tools/build.py regenerated them from another generation).

title: Add a pre-slate injury-report refresh before kickoffs
decision_impact: Keeps game-day reads aligned with the official report

title: Publish a categorized All Sections index so every finding is reachable from the landing page
decision_impact: A reviewer can reach every register, sub-site and finding in one click instead of guessing URLs
evidence: Crawl of index.html and pages/*.html showed zero inbound links to 15 root pages and both sub-sites (flag F37)

title: Consolidate the four flag registers (root F01-F39, pipeline F01-F18, referee R-xx, verified-lab V-xx) into one cross-referenced register
decision_impact: One place to triage every irregularity; removes the numbering collisions that already confused two sessions
evidence: Four registers with overlapping IDs are published in one repository; flag F-014 and F26 already record the duplication

title: Gate the published generation: verify the committed pages, not a regenerated substitute
decision_impact: CI would fail on a defect a reader can actually see, instead of on a page that is never published
evidence: tools/build.py rewrites index.html from a different template in CI than the published one (flag F38)

title: Commit generated pages back after each data-bot refresh, or add a staleness gate
decision_impact: Published injury counts, KPIs and edges always match the current official report
recommended_path: Regeneration step: implemented by session 3d5c5e2d in collect-data.yml. Remaining piece - staleness guard: review before implementing.
evidence: The 18:53 data refresh (254 -> 276 injury rows) was not reflected on the published site until a human regenerated it (flag F39); session 3d5c5e2d added the re-render step to the refresh job afterwards.
status: Partly implemented (re-render) - staleness guard awaiting review

title: Run the referee's independent replication as a CI gate so cross-session disagreements are caught automatically
decision_impact: Disputes like the C5 division count (flag F36) would fail the build instead of waiting for manual review
evidence: referee/tools/check_site.py and the replication harness independently reproduced -0.1048 where the repo published -0.1297
